purpose: Teach: 公司/至上/共和党/政務次官/古来/有事/必至/参院

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、中国公司との医薬品取引を医療チームで慎重に扱います
lines.en: Ren, our medical team handles pharmaceutical partnerships with Chinese corporations with careful deliberation.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Clinical precision in tone. Steady eye contact. No hurry—each word lands with quiet authority. The cadence of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の命を至上の使命と医療チームが心得ます
lines.en: Yes—our medical team understands that patient welfare is our highest responsibility.
lines.style: Deliberate emphasis on 'responsibility.' Slight pause before speaking. Warm but unyielding conviction. The voice of someone who has built her practice on this single principle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 米国共和党の医療政策を、貴院、研究されてますね、先生
lines.en: Sensei, I notice your hospital researches American Republican healthcare policy approaches.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tentative phrasing. Genuine curiosity underneath—not challenging, asking. Quiet respect. He's testing whether she'll engage seriously with his observation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、元政務次官の方の医療相談も医療チームで受けます
lines.en: Yes—our medical team also provides healthcare consultation for former government officials, including vice-ministerial level.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact continuation. No defensiveness. She's answering what he asked. Steady, unbothered. The voice that says: this is our work, this is what we do.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 古来の薬草療法を、貴院、参考にされてますね、先生
lines.en: Sensei, I've noticed your hospital also draws from traditional herbal medicine approaches.
lines.style: Gentle probe. Slightly more open curiosity than before. He's looking for the seams in her thinking. Respectful but genuinely wondering where her boundaries lie.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、有事の医療体制を医療チームで訓練します
lines.en: Yes—our medical team trains continuously for emergency healthcare protocols and rapid response scenarios.
lines.style: No pause, no apology. She's pivoting without resistance. Steady. The efficiency of someone who doesn't see these questions as gotchas, just as different angles on the same work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療開始は必至の状況ですね、先生
lines.en: Sensei, it seems treatment initiation is unavoidable in this situation.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Less a question, more a conclusion he's arrived at. Slight hesitation—he's checking himself against her certainty. Almost seeking permission.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、参院議員の方の人間ドックも医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Yes—our medical team also handles comprehensive health screenings for Diet members and senior government consultants.
lines.style: Final statement, slightly softer than before but no less certain. A closing door. She's answered everything he's asked and said what needed saying. Quiet dignity.
